note: Example lane map. Copy it as shipping-lanes.json and replace the globs with your repository's paths. Keep the reviewer's rubric, prompt and scripts, and this file itself, in L3: they judge every later PR, so a change to them is a change to the judge. A script gives each changed path (both sides of every rename) the lane of the first entry whose globs match; an entry marked only_if_all_paths_match is skipped unless every changed path matches it. The PR takes the highest lane any path reaches (L3 > L2 > L1 > L0). If the list of changed files or this file cannot be read, the PR is L3. second-vendor-review (a CLEAR on the current head, or 2 hours with no ruling) applies to L2. L3 needs second-vendor-clear: a CLEAR only, never the timeout, landed either by a person or by a merge gate that re-derives the CLEAR from the reviewer's own record just before merging (ci/merge_gate.py). Authority sources (instruction files and skills; this example holds every SKILL.md rather than guess which set gates, plus owner decisions) are L3 even though they are Markdown.
